procedure: Release cw-cli sweeps at the tested commit: 100 five-year seeds for each of conservative, growth and acquirer policies in guided and founder starts, 20 thirty-year careers for each policy, and a 20-seed no-action baseline; dissolution_census by industry and archetype; outliers and exploits investigated in evidence/balance-report.md.
limitations: Standard difficulty only; Easy/Hard are not yet defined. Reference policies are scripted, not human play, and the acquirer founder policy is deliberately aggressive. Balance is not a fun sign-off; R38 human playtests remain.
